title: Remove time
summary: Remove a stretch of the recording from the output, which becomes shorter. The original is untouched and processing still covers the whole recording: the removal is applied to the result, just before the final limiter. Positions are seconds of the original recording.

params.title: Fades at the join
params.help: The audio fades out before the join and back in after it, so the join does not click. 0 joins the samples directly.
